## Trust Derivation

Actions taken by any specialist agent are classified using four axes. The classification determines what is enforced at the config layer (`tools.allow` / `tools.deny` in `config/ts-harness-runtime.yaml`) and what requires human approval.

Operators extending the classification table must update `config/ts-harness-runtime.yaml` and the specialist catalog entry in `config/agents/catalog.yaml`, then regenerate docs with `scripts/generate-agent-docs.py`.
